name: B.L.Kashyap & Sons Ltd
about: B.L.Kashyap & Sons Ltd is an EPC company engaged in the business of Construction of Buildings High-Rise Residential and Commercial Complexes, IT Parks, Institutional Buildings, etc. [1]
keyPoints:
Overview[1]`
B L Kashyap & Sons Ltd. is one of the leading Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) Company, engaged in  civil construction and Infrastructure with a pan-India presence.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.07% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 7.39% over last 3 years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 99.4% of their holding.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.28.5 Cr.
